Reading the dashboard

Gold is a rough proxy for jewellery-sector input costs, not a stock-price forecast. Wholesale food prices are a single-day snapshot, averaged across the markets AFCD samples that day. Retail sales and restaurant receipts are official monthly/quarterly government indices, not real-time. The coverage table distinguishes live measures from sources whose endpoints are still broken or unverified. No stock ranking, forecast, or investment recommendation is produced.
